name: Perceive-Reason-Execute-Memory Loop
description: 100-line self-evolving loop: Perceive → reason → execute → write memory. Tasks crystallize into reusable SOPs building personal skill tree.
code:
# GenericAgent-style self-evolution loop
while not converged:
    state = perceive(current_state)       # 感知当前状态
    plan = reason(state, memory)          # 推理+规划
    result = execute(plan)                # 执行
    memory.write(f"Task crystallized into SOP: {plan.sop_id}")  # 写入记忆
    # Task → SOP 转化是关键：重复任务自动沉淀为可复用技能

name: Three-Tier Virtual Filesystem
description: Virtual filesystem where agents operate like files. Three loading tiers: cold (disk) → warm (cache) → hot (RAM). Sessions become memories via background extraction.
code:
# OpenViking-style 3-tier context loading
TIER_COLD = '/sessions/'   # disk: full session history
TIER_WARM = '/memory_cache/'  # RAM cache: last N sessions
TIER_HOT = '/active_context/'  # loaded: current task context

def load_context(task):
    # 1. Check hot tier first
    if task.id in TIER_HOT:
        return TIER_HOT[task.id]
    # 2. Try warm tier
    if task.id in TIER_WARM:
        data = TIER_WARM[task.id]
        TIER_HOT[task.id] = data  # Promote to hot
        return data
    # 3. Load from cold (disk) and promote
    data = read_from_disk(TIER_COLD + task.id)
    TIER_WARM[task.id] = data
    TIER_HOT[task.id] = data
    return data

name: Offline Memory Reflection
description: Between sessions, merge episode clusters and refine profiles. Local-first, Markdown-native, Git-versioned. Source files are readable and diffable.
code:
# EverOS-style offline reflection
def offline_reflection(sessions):
    # 1. Merge similar episodes
    clusters = merge_episodes(sessions, similarity_threshold=0.7)
    # 2. Refine user/profile from clusters
    for cluster in clusters:
        profile = refine_profile(cluster)
        save_profile(profile)
    # 3. Compress old sessions to maintain context window
    compress_old_sessions(cutoff_days=7)
    # Key insight: reflection happens OFFLINE, not during task execution

name: SOP Crystallization
description: Repeated tasks automatically crystallize into Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Seed skill tree starts at 3.3K lines, grows autonomously.
code:
# SOP crystallization from repeated tasks
SOP_THRESHOLD = 3  # repeat N times → crystallize

def crystallize_sop(task_history):
    if task_history.count(task_type) >= SOP_THRESHOLD:
        sop = extract_pattern(task_history)
        sop.validate()
        skill_registry.register(sop.name, sop)
        # Update task description to reference new SOP
        return f"Crystallized into SOP: {sop.name}"
    return None
